blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Lingayen Airport in Pangasinan will be temporarily closed from October 31 to November 1 due to the observance of Undas (All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day). The announcement comes from the Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (Caap) on Friday. In a statement, Caap said the Notice to Airmen will be effective from 7 a.m. of Saturday, October 31, to 4 p.m. of Sunday, November 1.
